name: Phainopepla
desc: Phainopepla (Phainopepla nitens): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 2,027 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The phainopepla or northern phainopepla is the most northerly representative of the mainly tropical Central American family Ptiliogonatidae, the silky flycatchers.
